# Camp Resource: Canned Coffee Machine

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Feb 19, 2024
- 3 min read

Updated: Aug 10, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a51e24d0935446f9807a32169f88ae33~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: __Mette__

__Slocum's Joe Coffee Machine__

Add a jolt of caffeine to your C.A.M.P. with the Slocum's Joe Coffee Machine!

Slocum's Joe Coffee Machine dispenses Canned Coffee.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6688f42ea9eb4bc98e869cf836dc8c21~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Canned Coffee - AP Refill Buff

Canned Coffee counts as Pre-war food for Collect and Consume Score Challenges.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6cf92d8a0fae42aaa1d2df60d1820c49~mv2.png)

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Slocum's Joe Coffee Machine

Slocum's Flavorful Coffee Machine

Red Rocket Coffee Machine

The Sicilian Espresso Machine

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

4 Canned Coffee

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __Slocum's Joe Mega Bundle__ - 1500 atoms 

Atom Shop - __Slocum's Coffee Machine__ - 500 Atoms

Atom Shop - __Cold Shoulder Bundle__ - 1000 Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

Every 7 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

None

#### **Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit

Hi, I'm Kat or Duchess

I'm an Australian data miner who writes farming, event, and food buff guides for Fallout 76.

I believe that all knowledge and information should be free, which is why my guides will never be locked behind a paywall. However, running a website and photo and video editing software does not come cheaply.

So, If you found my guides helpful, please consider buying me a ko-fi (coffee) using the link below.

All monies go towards the tools for writing my guides and maybe for an actual cup of coffee or 3 ;)
